facts.value: Obtains the Fighter from gobj and saves its current motion_id into mv.co.parasol_open.prev_msid. Opening-motion selection tests whether the fighter is Peach and u.pe.parasol_gobj_0 is non-null, choosing ftPe_MS_ItemParasolOpen in that case and ftCo_MS_ItemParasolOpen otherwise; it does not classify normalized Parasol status. The selected motion is passed to Fighter_ChangeMotionState with flags 0, animation start 0.0f, speed 1.0f and blend 10.0f. After ftAnim_8006EBA4, shared initialization clears x2221_b7 and sets x2221_b4; if x2221_b6 is set, it copies p_ftCommonData->x59C to x2104 and clears x2221_b6. The formal integer arg1 is unused, including when Peach callers pass attribute x90 instead of common x59C.
facts.rationale: Corrects the baseline's conflation of the status classifier used by the eligibility predicate with the character/article-pointer selector used by entry. Preserves every local write, the conditional initialization and the caller/callee argument mismatch.
